g.text: Purple (#8a3ffc): IBM Verify Identity Access | Cyan (#0072c3): HashiCorp Vault | Blue (#0f62fe): EKS / Agent pods
Teal (#007d79): Amazon RDS PostgreSQL | Green (#198038): Amazon Bedrock AI | Gray (#525252): AWS managed services
Thick purple arrow between Vault <-> IVIA = JWKS validation — THE SEAM (identity propagation boundary)
